model-final-01:001.rationale: Align the receiving shaft with the roll axis while keeping the jaws retracted and the loaded donor extended.

model-final-01:002.rationale: The measured receiver height and lateral position are aligned. Insert to the documented depth with the core grip collapsed and donor support maintained.

model-final-01:003.rationale: The insertion encoder is at 240 mm. Expand the geared chuck and wait for actual pad-force readings before changing donor support.

model-final-01:004.rationale: All three pads carry several kilonewtons, but the donor still supports about 2 kN. Raise the receiving setpoint slightly to preload its support, then recheck the donor gauge before withdrawal.

model-final-01:005.rationale: The donor load fell substantially but remains about 380 N. Increase the receiving height setpoint by another 0.2 mm and check that the donor unloads while all pad contacts remain strong.

model-final-01:006.rationale: The donor gauge now reads zero and every pad retains strong contact. Withdraw the donor through its full stroke while holding the receiver alignment and gripping force.

model-final-01:007.rationale: The donor is fully withdrawn and unloaded, with all three pads gripping. Move the supported roll to the marked lateral destination and compensated lift setpoint, then allow the carriage to settle before requesting the load test.
